title: GoldenClaims
description: Buy Claims with GOLD! Simple as that.
body:
Welcome to **GoldenClaims**, the friendly Minecraft plugin that lets you claim and protect your land! Whether you're building a cozy home, a massive castle, or just want to keep your crops safe from griefers, GoldenClaims has got you covered. With a simple golden shovel tool and an intuitive claiming system, you can secure your territory in no time.

## Features

- **Easy Land Claiming**: Use the special golden shovel to select and claim areas
- **Block Protection**: Keep your builds safe from other players
- **Economy Integration**: Buy claim blocks using in-game gold
- **Multi-Language Support**: Available in Portuguese, English, and Chinese
- **Visual Feedback**: See your claims highlighted in the world
- **Claim Management**: List, expand, and manage your claims easily

## How to Use

### Getting Started

First, get your claim tool:
```
/claimtool
```

This gives you a special golden shovel that you'll use for all claiming activities.

### Selecting Your Land

1. Hold the golden shovel in your hand
2. **Left-click** a block to set the first corner of your claim
3. **Right-click** a block to set the second corner

The area between these two points will become your claim!

### Buying Claim Blocks

You need claim blocks to create claims. Buy them with gold:
```
/claim buy <amount>
```

For example, `/claim buy 10` will let you buy claim blocks with 10 gold ingots.

### Creating Your Claim

Once you have enough claim blocks and have selected an area:
```
/claim create
```

Your land is now protected!

### Expanding Your Claim
If you wish to expand you claim, click any corner of the claim and select the next further point to expand your claim. You will be asked to confirm in chat!

### Managing Your Claims

Check your claim blocks balance:
```
/claim blocks
```

List all your claims:
```
/claim list
```

Change language (Portuguese, English, or Chinese):
```
/claim language <pt/en/zh>
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/claimtool` | Get your golden claim shovel |
| `/claim buy <gold>` | Buy claim blocks with gold |
| `/claim blocks` | Check your claim blocks balance |
| `/claim create` | Create a claim from your selection |
| `/claim list` | List all your claims |
| `/claim language <lang>` | Change your language |

## Configuration

Edit `config.yml` to customize:

- Database settings
- Gold-to-claim ratio
- Maximum claim blocks per player
